# televerse

**Tag**: telegram, bot, chat, telegram-bot-api, bot-framework, web, testing

## 简介

Televerse lets you create your own efficient Telegram bots with ease in Dart. Supports latest Telegram Bot API - 10.2!

## 官网

- 主页: https://televerse.weaverlabs.ca
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/theweaverlabs/televerse
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/televerse
